app.title: ECD Epitope Workbench

form.exportOfflineTitle: Export a single-file offline report (structure included)
status.initial: Load the frozen PD-L1 example, or submit a UniProt / PDB ID.
hud.hint: Drag to rotate · scroll to zoom · right-drag to pan
hud.canvasHint: Load the example or submit a protein to show the structure
seqdock.title: Sequence alignment
seqdock.loadFirst: Load a result to see the alignment.
upload.title: Upload a downloaded structure
upload.hint: Only an antigen-ECD PDB/mmCIF is required. The longest protein chain and the fixed Jurkat-Fab x K562-antigen topology are used to design at most six coarse-mapping probes.
upload.manual: Advanced optional overrides: chain, canonical sequence, or ECD boundaries
af3.title: Provide official AF3 output
af3.hint: Requires the top-ranked mmCIF and its confidences JSON. AFDB/AF2 is never treated as AF3.
af3.confirm: I confirm these files come from official AlphaFold 3 output
overview.relativeAxis: C-terminal anchor-relative axis (not a physical membrane plane)
s1.detailEmpty: Pick a residue in the structure, sequence or list.
s1.src.title: Structure source
s2.passedTable: Substitutions that passed the single-point gate (ΔΔG shows FoldX values only)
s2.noPassed: No substitution record passed the single-point gate for this construct.
s2.boundaryBody: Computational pre-screening is not experimental confirmation; epitope attribution still requires expression, conformational antibody, stability and function readouts.
s2.criteriaEmpty: Load a result to see the quantitative criteria.
crit.surface: Dual threshold on rSASA and side-chain SASA; see the methods card.
crit.folding: On top of the surface gate, disulfide cysteines, annotated glycans/PTMs and low-confidence sites are excluded; means low predicted risk, not experimental confirmation.
crit.interface: Any target heavy atom within 5 Å of a non-target chain or hetero residue; functional interfaces keep their risk flag.
crit.regions: Fab-footprint patches; see the patch card for counts and coverage.
crit.design: FoldX single-point gate is exposure-linked (+0.46/+0.60/+0.80 kcal/mol); combination gate +2.0 kcal/mol; mutations pairwise ≥5.5 Å apart within ≤22 Å spread.
crit.default: This layer can be overlaid with the others.
fold.note: This module renders ONLY energy scores actually computed by FoldX / EvoEF2. When the engine produced no score, no number is shown — only a status.
fold.pickDesign: Pick a recommended probe in step 5 and its real FoldX score appears here.
fold.pendingBody: The combination and single-point energies of this construct have not been produced by FoldX/EvoEF2, so no number is shown here — showing one would be misleading.
fold.howto: Submit a real job with the FoldX engine available (vendor/foldx present or FOLDX_PATH set) and true kcal/mol values will appear here.
region.note: Fab-footprint patches: 13 Å geodesic radius AND ≤18 Å euclidean to the seed, cross-domain allowed; click a patch header to focus it.
iface.note: Interface residues come from measured 5 Å chain-partner contacts in this structure — the partner that actually exists here, not a prediction. Monomer/apo structures have no interface to show.
iface.none: No protein partner in this structure; the interface overlay is unavailable.
design.note: One Stage-1 probe per patch (3-6 points, anchor included); the list also holds alternates and Stage-2 single/pair presets (order those only after a hit). HIGH patches carry two probes.
design.proxyHidden: no real energy score · proxy hidden
design.surfaceCoordinateNote: The surface uses the input structure. Red surface patches mark WT sites; labels denote planned substitutions, not post-mutation atomic conformations.
s5.exportsEmpty: JSON, CSV, FASTA, GenBank, methods report and ZIP appear once the analysis completes.
s5.noFiles: No downloadable files for this result.
custom.note: Pick a residue and target amino acid in the residue detail (step 1), then add it to the construct; click the 3D view or bottom sequence letters to locate residues.
custom.name: Construct name
custom.forceRisk: Explicitly keep high-risk substitutions (protected sites still cannot be forced)
custom.demoNote: Editable preview on the frozen demo; submit a real job to save and export.
custom.saving: Validating and generating the ECD sequence…
rd.choices: Candidate substitutions (ΔΔG shows FoldX values only)
rd.noScan: No substitution scan stored for this residue in this structure.
rd.listEmpty: No residues match the current filter.
msg.loadingDemo: Loading the frozen PD-L1 review result
msg.demoReady: Frozen PD-L1 example; submit a real job to save custom constructs and export
msg.savedJobFail: Could not load the requested job:
msg.sseLostHint: Refresh the job status or resubmit.
msg.beadsNeedJob: The frozen demo has no job structure file; submit a real job to use beads rendering
msg.exportNeedJob: Submit and complete a real job before exporting the offline report
msg.customAdded: added to the construct (view/save in step 6)
seq.customNoCDS: Custom constructs do not recompute codons; CDS copy unavailable
note.disclaimer: Computational pre-screening means low predicted risk only; epitope attribution still requires expression, conformational control antibodies, stability and function readouts.
tol.note: FoldX single-point gate: ΔΔG ≤ +0.46 kcal/mol to enter combination search. The table lists substitutions that passed for the probe key sites.
design.proxyWarn: Note: this score is a dimensionless proxy, not kcal/mol.
custom.saved: saved and added to the export files.
surface.note: Surface gate: rSASA >= 0.25 AND side-chain SASA >= 20 A2. Only gated residues enter the design pool.
